prepared_operator_packet.finding_1_abstract: In six focal Camp Fire-area Butte County tracts, provided Overture-to-USFS building-count ratios ranged from 0.620 to 0.747. The tract-level difference suggests a post-fire mapping discrepancy, but the county-cluster 95% interval includes zero, so its magnitude remains exploratory. A preregistered CAL FIRE DINS check did not support the proposed damage/rebuilding mechanism: 0/6 focal tracts met relative error <=0.30, and Spearman was 0.4626068 across 28 tracts, below 0.60. DINS is inspection-limited; missing records do not establish absence or rebuilding. This motivates localized mapping QA, not a causal claim or observed service failure.
